knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Load functions/packages:
```{r}
source("sim_mean_sd.R")
library(tidyverse)
```
## Create a sim:
```{r}
output = vector("list", 1000)

for (i in 1:1000) {
  output[[i]] = sim_mean_sd(30)
}

sim_results = bind_rows(output)
```

## Inspect Results:

```{r}
## Look at mean output:
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mu_hat),
    emp_se = sd(mu_hat)
  )

## Plot outputs:
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mu_hat)) +
  geom_density()
```

## DO this using tibbles and map:

```{r}
sim_results_df = 
  tibble(
    sample_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(sample_size, sim_mean_sd)
    ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```

## Look at results:
```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mu_hat)) +
  geom_density()
```


## Change `n`
```{r, cache = TRUE}
sim_results_df = 
 expand_grid(
   samp_size = c(30, 60, 120, 240),
   iter = 1:1000
 ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
    ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = samp_size, y = mu_hat)) +
  geom_violin()
```




## Simple Linear Regression... !!! (SLR)
```{r}
sim_data =
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(30, mean = 1, sd = 1),
    y = 2 + 3*x + rnorm(30, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  )

sim_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)

fit = sim_data |> 
  lm(y ~ x, data = _)
```
## Run with sim_slr:
```{r}
source("sim_slr.R")

slr_results_df = 
 expand_grid(
   samp_size = c(30, 60, 120, 240),
   iter = 1:1000
 ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_slr)
    ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```

```{r}
slr_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = beta0_hat, y = beta1_hat, color = factor(samp_size))) +
  geom_point()
```

## Birthday Problem:
```{r}
birthdays = sample(1:365, size = 5, replace = TRUE)

repeated_birthdays = length(unique(birthdays)) < 5

print(repeated_birthdays)
```

turn this into a function

```{r}
source("birthday_repeated.R")

birthday_repeated(100)
```

## Run it a bunch:
```{r}
birthday_results_df = 
  tibble(
    number_of_people = rep(5, 10000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    repeated = map_lgl(number_of_people, birthday_repeated)
  )

birthday_large_df = 
  expand_grid(
   number_of_people = c(5:100),
   iter = 1:1000
 ) |> 
  mutate(
    repeated = map_lgl(number_of_people, birthday_repeated)
  ) |> 
  group_by(number_of_people) |> 
  summarize(p = mean(repeated))
```

```{r}
birthday_large_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = number_of_people, y = p)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()
```
